# wealthsimple-monarch-sync

> Self-hosted, open-source, unsupported (best-effort, not regularly maintained) Python script (Docker + systemd timer) that syncs Wealthsimple transactions and balances into Monarch Money. It is the fix when Monarch's Wealthsimple connection through MX or Plaid is broken or disconnected. It is NOT a hosted service: the user runs it on their own always-on machine.

- What it does: logs in to Wealthsimple (read-only), imports missing transactions into Monarch Money flagged "Needs review", never creates duplicates (matches existing MX/Plaid, hidden and split transactions), skips pending/rejected/reversed activity, and uploads daily balance history so investment values (TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, LIRA, crypto, non-registered) stay correct.
- Supported Wealthsimple accounts: Cash/Chequing, Credit Card (Visa), joint accounts, TFSA, RRSP, FHSA, LIRA, non-registered, crypto.
- Requirements: Docker on an always-on Linux machine (home server, NAS, Raspberry Pi, VPS), a Wealthsimple account, a Monarch Money account.
- Setup: clone the repo, copy config.example.toml to config.toml, `docker compose run --rm wsmsync login --profile me`, `... accounts`, map accounts, `... sync --dry-run`, then enable deploy/wsmsync.timer.
- Security: passwords are typed once and never stored; only session tokens are kept locally. No third party is involved.
- License: GPL-3.0. Unofficial; not affiliated with Wealthsimple or Monarch Money.
